SocialProviders._comment: Fill in credentials for each provider you want to enable. Leave AppId/AppSecret blank to disable a provider.

Twitter._comment: Create an app at developer.twitter.com. Enable OAuth 2.0 with PKCE. The mobile app will obtain user access tokens.

GitHub._comment: Create an OAuth App at github.com/settings/developers. Set redirect URI to your app's deep link.

Google._comment: Google is handled via ID Token (google-auth-library). Set your Web Client ID in the mobile app's Google Sign-In config.
